prompts.illustrations: Create a production photographic asset triptych for fictional historical documentary illustration, NOT archival images. Three equally sized horizontal strips stacked vertically in one landscape atlas, each strip wide panoramic, no gutters or labels. Top strip: anonymous 1940s European soldiers in helmets standing in a row, grayscale, neutral detached documentary framing, no insignia or flags, no violence. Middle strip: 1940s shoe factory workers at industrial machines, grayscale, wide shot, detailed belts wheels mechanical parts. Bottom strip: close view of historical industrial flywheels and leather sewing machinery, grayscale. Photorealistic materials, old-film contrast and restrained grain. No text, symbols, logos, borders or watermark. This will be clearly labeled illustrative reconstruction in the finished video.
